result: Fixed all Slice 07 Physics/Math bugs (sweep initial overlap rejection tmin<0, accumulator remainder modulo on maxSubSteps, consolidated 64-bit BigInt pairKey, ContactSolver pair-state pool leak recycling, OBB.clone _localCenter copy) and Slice 06 Geometry bugs (TriStar outward normal & winding, Annulus +Y CCW winding, Tube unshared cap vertices & UV-V mirror, CutCylinder avgH axis top point & trapezoid surface area). All 30 physics test suites and all geometry test suites pass with 0 regressions.

Fixed glTF/OBJ loaders (stride, signed component types, normalized accessors, negative relative OBJ indices), Maker project loading & autosave (schemaVersion 2), ActionChips explicit tokens & CanvasOps scale/rotate bounds, Whisper StageMovementBehavior cleanup, and Showcase 13 time update & doubly-linked showcase navigation.

Welle 0 fixes completed: (1) Light Shafts intensity²/color² unified, linearized/relative depthThreshold exposed, dead uniforms removed, _vaoShafts typo fixed, compile/link error check & shader leak cleanup; (2) Frostglass pulse-lane scaling removed in WGSL; GLSL100 screen-UV derived from v_clipPos; (3) DynamicReflectionProbe scene.root parent bug fixed and try...finally restoring render target & MathPool vectors added to DynamicReflectionProbe and PlanarReflectionNode; (4) Fail-fast capacity checks (instance count, buffer bounds, bone capacity >2048, and lights limits) symmetrically implemented across WebGPU, WebGL2, and WebGL1; all 279 test suites (1895 tests) passing, clean lint and build.

outcome: Welle 0 (Sofort-Fixes / Quick Wins) erfolgreich und vollständig umgesetzt über alle 3 Subagents (Bob: Rendering & Shaders & Capacity, Charlie: Physics & Geometry, Dave: Loaders, Tools & Apps). 100% Tests grün (279 Files, 1895 Tests), Lint und Build fehlerfrei.
